title: AGENTSAFE: Benchmarking the Safety of Embodied Agents on Hazardous Instructions
reasoning: The paper presents AGENTSAFE, a benchmark explicitly designed to systematically evaluate the safety and ethical reasoning of embodied VLM agents. The task suite, SAFE-VERSE, is inspired by Asimov's Three Laws of Robotics and categorizes hazards into risks to humans, the environment, and the agent itself, testing the agent's ability to refuse unethical or harmful instructions.
